arguments.message: Quinn planning proposal: because all my meetings are SOFT and overlaps across my own meetings are penalized, I want a non-overlapping chain that still maximizes overlap with others. Tentative picks: m015 Lunch [1,3), m002 Board game [3,6), m009 Gaming [7,9), m001 Music [11,15). Skip the other overlapping options unless there is strong group preference for a different representative in those windows. If others can align to these windows, we get broad overlap without self-conflict. Please share your preferred picks, especially for 1-6 and 11-15.

Quinn to Taylor: my tentative non-overlapping plan is Lunch [1,3), then one 3-6 activity (currently Board game m002), then Gaming [7,9), then Music [11,15). Since we share many meetings, if you have strong preferences among the 3-6 block (m002/m011/m007/m012/m006/m016/m004 tail) or late block (m008 vs m001), let me know and I can adapt to improve overlap.

Riley planning proposal: all my meetings are SOFT, so I also prefer a non-overlapping chain through the busy windows. Tentative attendance: m013 Gaming [1,2), then m014 Lunch [2,4) (or m003 same window/group subset), then m002 Board game [4,6) OR m016 art [4,6) depending group convergence, then m009 Gaming [7,9), then m001 Music [11,15). I plan to skip overlapping alternatives in 2-6 and 11-14 if we can coordinate on these anchors. Preference order for 2-6 is lunch [2,4) + one representative [4,6) meeting, with board game slightly preferred as larger group. If others prefer m011 swim or m016 art for [4,6), I can switch.

Jordan planning proposal: to avoid self-overlap penalties, I also prefer a non-overlapping chain aligned with shared high-participation meetings. Tentative picks: m015 Lunch [1,3), m002 Board game [3,6), m009 Gaming [7,9), m001 Music [11,15). I would then skip overlapping alternatives m013/m014/m005/m016/m004/m011/m006/m007/m012 in 1-6, and skip m008 in 11-14 if we converge on m001. This matches Quinn’s proposal and mostly matches Riley except I favor full m002 [3,6) over splitting lunch [2,4)+other [4,6), since a single shared representative avoids fragmentation. If others strongly prefer m014 [2,4) plus a [4,6) meeting, I can switch, but my first choice is the chain above.

Avery planning proposal: I support the same non-overlapping anchor chain as Quinn/Jordan for maximum broad overlap and no self-conflict: m015 Lunch [1,3), m002 Board game [3,6), m009 Gaming [7,9), m001 Music [11,15). This covers the densest shared windows and avoids splitting attendance across overlapping 2-6 and 11-14 options. I prefer skipping m013/m003/m014/m005/m004/m011/m006/m007 in 1-6, and skipping m008 in 11-14, unless the group strongly converges elsewhere. Riley: if you’re flexible, I’d encourage m002 [3,6) rather than splitting [2,4)+[4,6), since several of us are already leaning there. (phase=planning, iter=1)
